title: Ship's pre-push check reads the PR body's Weakens-tests line
body:
Why: on 2026-11-14 the t-kynrffp lane's bin/krn pr ship exited 81 at the pre-push fast run on weak-tests although the PR body carried a Weakens-tests: line; it passed only after the lane exported PR_BODY by hand.
Outcome: krn pr ship passes --body-file to the pre-push check (PR_BODY or equivalent), so a declared Weakens-tests line is honoured exactly as CI honours it.
Proof: a ship test with a body carrying Weakens-tests and a weakened test asserts no exit 81; npm run fast PASS.
